title: Vegan Fish-Free Fish Tacos
description: A creative vegan twist on traditional fish tacos, featuring croatian-inspired flavors and textures.

ingredients.name: Vegan fish-free fillets (such as tofu or tempeh)
Vegan sour cream (such as cashew or soy-based)

instructions: 1. Preheat a non-stick skillet or grill pan over medium-high heat.
2. In a shallow dish, mix together the bread crumbs, toasted xeriscape seeds, and vegan taco seasoning.
3. Dip each vegan fish-free fillet into the bread crumb mixture, pressing gently to coat.
4. Add the coated fillets to the preheated skillet or grill pan and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until golden brown and crispy.
5. Meanwhile, mix together the bisque-flavored vegan Worcestershire sauce, lime juice, and a pinch of salt and pepper in a small bowl.
6. Once the fillets are cooked, place them on a plate and brush with the sauce mixture.
7. Warm vegan taco shells according to package instructions.
8. Assemble the tacos by placing a fillet into each shell, followed by a dollop of vegan sour cream, a sprinkle of cilantro, and a slice of avocado.
